name: @playliquid/sensory-runtime
description: PlayLiquid GameOS sensory runtime (PL-027). The simulation/lab host of sensor EXECUTION for composed avatars (avatar-runtime PL-026 deliberately left execution to the runtimes): typed per-channel SensorySample records that REFINE avatar-runtime's SensorSample (channel id, frozen game-contracts SensorCapabilityId, channel-appropriate typed payload shapes, content digest, epoch); per-capability codec admission of raw producer frames with total validation and kebab-case typed refusals (capability/channel binding coherence, range and normalization invariants); a deterministic host that binds a composed avatar (R5 restriction projection included) to per-channel producer ports under an injected ServiceClock, records restriction filtering as POLICY rather than silence, and appends admitted samples to a content-addressed append-only sensory history (E10: immutable, digest-pinned, idempotent by content key — same key, recorded receipt, no second mutation). The perception seam: a SensorInputPort adapter feeds the history to avatar-runtime's existing perception→decision→action driver unmodified (contracts-only import of the managed module). Tenancy (R20): all records and polls are tenant-scoped; cross-tenant reads/probes are typed refusals. Pure domain: clock and producers are ports; in-memory seeded fakes are the only in-repo implementation; no rendering, no audio capture, no device IO, no physics, no Math.random, no wall-clock, no globals (E3/E9).
